owner_approval: Proceed following recommendation to qualify and run one bounded investigation
input_review_method: Full initial native input and every subsequent actual changed field/appended event, with exact unchanged system/settings/history and native user-state inclusion checked; full thinking/finals/results and next decisions directly read.
residual_friction: Repeated deliberation on the same repair, action order and supplied guards, mixed with useful edge-case checks.
Session-ownership uncertainty in 011 and previous-session wording in 013 despite annotation; current candidate/check use remains correct.
Tentative file-size misidentification in 012 without additional navigation.
retained: Complete source-checked tool reference and repaired return contract
Consulted task-author episode annotation and actual event/check state
Unchanged q4/56,576, no MTP, uncapped xhigh settings
deferred: Exact host-generated grouping and explicit measurement-object scope if consequences earn it
A working account if a task establishes a practical need; not permanently excluded
conversation_policy: For a consequential misunderstanding, preserve and diagnose actual input/output, then scope a small separate neutral Qwen conversation before settling presentation. Long thinking or an available suggestion alone does not activate dialogue or a comparison.
limits: Authored thirteen-file development fixture; no hidden grader or general-correctness claim.
Correct source-led repair before first check; no failed-repair recovery or failed-diagnostic-driven reversal.
All history resident and thinking omitted immediately; no pressure boundary or 25k contrast.
No matched presentation or reasoning-setting comparison; no causal attribution of length, annotation benefit or cross-task speed.
next: Retain interface. Future investigation preparation should qualify observable diagnostic distinctions beyond a small source mismatch without requiring a wrong first action, forced check or padding.
next_live_scope: No automatic successor, dialogue, retry or comparison; requires a concrete separately authorized scope.
